select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, SAI.ACCT_NO AS acctNo, SAI.ACCT_NAME as acctName, DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mDate, IFNULL(bb.o_amt,0) as theoryIntAmt, d.trade_Amt as realIntAmt, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy FROM trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SAI ON D.FINPROD_ID=SAI.ACCT_NO
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD EXT ON D.TRADE_ID=EXT.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BSET ON '不进行关联'=BSET.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_BALANCE BB ON BSET.BOOKSET_ID=BB.BOOKSET_ID AND BB.SUBJECT_NO='12040101' AND BB.BALANCE_DATE =d.trade_date - 1
left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc ON zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}

select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, '' as 资金账户名, '' as 资金账户账号, DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mDate, '' as 理论利息, d.INT_AMT as realIntAmt, d.CCY as ccy, LIMIT as num from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' where 1=1
and d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
